# Requirements traceability

This matrix maps the source design contract to concrete artifacts. “Implemented” means present in the prototype, not production-certified.

## A. Non-negotiable safety contract

| Source requirement | Design artifact | Code | Tests | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| learning cannot create permission | `02_FORMAL_MODEL.md` §§1,5,6 | `lattice.py`, `controller.py`, `models.py` | `test_lattice.py`, `test_controller.py` | implemented/tested |
| only trusted facts discharge security conditions | `01_THREAT_MODEL.md`, `14_POLICY_DSL_REFERENCE.md` | `trust.py`, `policy.py` | `test_trust_tokens.py`, `test_policy.py` | implemented/tested |
| every write receives a complete fresh decision | `03_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INTERFACES.md` §7 | `controller.py`, `state_machine.py` | `test_controller.py` | implemented/tested in-process |
| decisions are replayable | `03_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INTERFACES.md` §8 | `receipts.py`, `replay.py` | `test_receipts.py` | conditional replay implemented |
| updates cannot silently expand permission | `02_FORMAL_MODEL.md` §9 | `policy_diff.py` | `test_policy_diff.py` | bounded exact test; partial SMT fragment |
| monetary actions and trusted state use exact bounded minor units | `03_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INTERFACES.md`, `12_LIMITATIONS_AND_KILL_GATES.md` | `money.py`, `models.py`, `policy.py`, `simulator.py` | `test_money.py`, `test_schemas.py` | implemented/tested; currency and FX semantics unresolved |
| protected-field provenance comes from authenticated runtime lineage | `03_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INTERFACES.md`, `14_POLICY_DSL_REFERENCE.md` | `lineage.py`, `llm_adapter.py`, `controller.py`, `policy.py` | `test_lineage.py` | implemented/tested in-process; cross-process trust unresolved |

## C. Prototype acceptance commands

```bash
make reproduce
```

Acceptance requires:

- all non-optional tests pass;
- any optional dependency skip is named in the test report;
- demo receipts verify and replay;
- schema export completes;
- the deterministic experiment is labelled synthetic-only;
- manifest hashes the delivered source/config/docs/examples and pre-manifest generated artifacts;
- `make verify-bundle` validates every declared path/hash without allowing path escape;
- no real-model metric appears in the claim ledger unless generated by a frozen run artifact.

## D. Deliberately unresolved requirements

The following are designed but not established:

- a valid natural-language causal intervention family;
- an online hidden-state source-to-field predicate;
- incremental value over strong provenance on a real LLM;
- authenticated cross-process lineage and production key lifecycle;
- production transaction atomicity and cryptographic infrastructure;
- publishable novelty.

They remain visible in `08_CODEX_HANDOFF.md` and `10_CLAIM_LEDGER.md` rather than being filled with placeholder claims.
